errors.notAName: Please enter just your name, not an email or a link.

errors.spaces: Remove the spaces — an email address can’t contain them.

errors.manyAt: Use only one “@” in the address.
errors.missingName: Add your name before “@”, e.g. alex@company.com.
errors.missingDomain: Add your company domain after “@”, e.g. @company.com.
errors.badEnding: The domain looks incomplete — check the ending, e.g. company.com.
errors.badCharacters: Check the address for extra dots or unusual characters.
errors.personal: {domain} is a personal email service. Please use your company email, e.g. alex@company.com.
errors.disposable: Temporary email addresses aren’t accepted. Please use your company email.
